verdict.rationale: v0 is itself described as an AI agent/assistant that plans, creates tasks, generates code, fixes errors/deployments, and connects to backends autonomously (v0-docs-35, v0-docs-9, v0-probe-1), and community evidence confirms users delegate full app-building tasks to it (v0-comm-1). This is a built-in assistant within the product itself, not an external tool. missing for 10: independent verification of the 'delegate and walk away' agentic loop end-to-end, and more detail on how much autonomous multi-step task execution occurs without user intervention.
